marketplace.name: genfeedai
marketplace.description: AI skills for Genfeed content creation, optimization, GTM strategy, advertising, and Genfeed integration, grouped into one module per platform or discipline

x.description: X (Twitter): posts, threads, Articles and account warmup

linkedin.description: LinkedIn: posts, articles and newsletter editions, carousels and account warmup

instagram.description: Instagram: feed posts, carousels, Reels, Stories and account warmup

youtube.description: YouTube: video scripts, Shorts, titles, descriptions, thumbnails, video analysis and channel warmup

tiktok.description: TikTok: videos, titles, descriptions and account warmup

writing.description: Long-form and conversion writing: blogs, newsletters, launch copy, internal comms and humanizing

content.description: Content strategy, operations, repurposing, review, SEO, GEO and competitor analysis

media.description: Images, video and visual systems: prompting, generation, local renderers (carousels, thumbnails, clips, motion) and brand kits

ads.description: Paid advertising: ad copy, UGC ad prompts and performance analysis

gtm.description: Go-to-market strategy: brand, positioning, ICP, offers, pricing, funnels, traffic, outbound and retention

loop.description: The Genfeed content loop: trend scouting, the loop orchestrator, Genfeed connector and Brand OS, publishing and analytics
